Porto Notes is implemented and verified. **Summary of what was built:** - `index.html` — static shell with the required `#note-form`, `#search`, `#results-line`, `#feed` elements plus labels for accessibility. - `src/main.ts` — full app logic: localStorage-backed notes seeded from `src/fixtures.json` (copied from the fixture file) on first load, a whitelist-based rich-text renderer for `/////
` plus newline-to-`
` conversion (everything else HTML-escaped, so script/attribute injection is neutralized), case-insensitive title/body search with the `results for "…"` line, note selection with `aria-current="true"`, and URL-fragment sync/restore (`#q=…¬e=…`) via `history.replaceState` + a `hashchange` listener. - `src/style.css` — lightweight styling, no dependencies added. Verified via a scripted Playwright pass (build + serve + headless browser): seed order, rich text/link rendering, search filtering, deep-link hash read/write and reload restore, form submit/clear, XSS payloads render as inert escaped text, and persistence across reloads all behave correctly. `pnpm build` and `pnpm smoke` both pass.
